limitations: An unrestricted Gaussian distribution assigns positive mass to invalid physical probabilities outside \([0,1]\).
No theorem for discrete mutation, bounded trait spaces, finite stochastic populations, or empirical epidemics.
The explicit increase–decrease–increase example asserts at least two turning points, not their exact count.
Historical priority remains literature-bounded; no independent audit.
scientific_integrity.proof: Global existence, Gaussian-mixture invariance, analytic susceptibility exhaustion, a sharp cubic optimization, and a rational sign certificate.
scientific_integrity.reproducibility: Stand-alone verify.py reproduces symbolic Gaussian PDE identities, rational bounds and numerical quadrature.
scientific_integrity.scope: Exact analytic result for the full-real-line continuum infectivity coordinate; the bounded physical infectivity interpretation is excluded.

title: Sharp mutation threshold and re-entrant infectivity variance in a bimodal evolving SIR model
